fact: The World Bank's digital economy diagnostic states that the central network of the government, partly hosted by CNIAPGE, does not extend to local government branches; it gives no date, so the document's published year is used.

The World Bank states that many ministries at the centre operate on manual systems and that this is more pronounced at the local level, for want of funds and adequate infrastructure, with data shared between ministries by hand, USB drive or e-mail; no date is given, so the document's published year is used.
